environment: The article page scrolls down, displaying text discussing LLM memory transfer bottlenecks between DRAM and SRAM computing units, and explaining solutions including compute-in-memory (存算一体) and wafer-scale integration (晶圆级集成).
text_visible: 在这一背景下，一个关键的性能提升瓶颈凸显：数据搬运。在传统计算架构中，一次推理过程往往需要在大容量DRAM与SRAM与计算单元之间反复读写数据...
为此，一种极具潜力的思路应运而生：彻底消除数据搬运。这引出了两条备受关注的技术路径：存算一体与晶圆级集成。
存算一体：将存储与计算融合在同一芯片内，使数据在原地完成处理，避免频繁搬运。
晶圆级集成：直接在整片硅晶圆上构建超大规模系统，通过超高带宽互连，实现晶圆级的统一内存与计算资源。

To the left is an older multi-storey residential tenement building with exterior air conditioning units and closed roll-down metal shutters on the ground floor. Overhead on the right spans a massive concrete elevated highway viaduct supported by thick pillars. High streetlamps cast warm yellow light across the asphalt and concrete street. High-rise residential towers with scattered lit windows rise against the dark night sky in the background. Two distant pedestrians (an adult and child) are walking further uphill. Objects: Concrete road with asphalt patches and drainage grates; white painted traffic markings ('慢駛' and 'SLOW') on the road; metal pedestrian fence along the left sidewalk; a traffic signpost with warning and regulatory signs at the corner; a dark red car parked on the left curb ahead; a blue SUV parked further uphill; empty hands while walking. Screen content: None. World text: '慢駛' and 'SLOW' painted on the street surface; '4.7m' height limit plate on the signpost; shop signs above closed shutters. Media: None. Ambient audio: Strong gusting nighttime wind noise and distant traffic rumble.
speech: 真是 crazy
details: I walk uphill on the left side of the road, looking down towards the curb as I speak.

action: I say '风' while looking uphill at the road ahead.

environment: No change.

details: I walk forward up the slope, my gaze shifting from the metal railing on the left to my shadow on the street surface.

action: I look up towards the elevated highway viaduct overhead and the corner building on the left as I walk up the incline.

action: I examine the traffic sign pole and shuttered storefront on the ground floor of the corner building.

action: I walk past the parked red car on the left, looking across the street toward the fenced park under the highway flyover.

action: I continue walking uphill, looking straight ahead along the slope toward a blue car parked in the distance.
action_brief: I walk towards a parked blue car.

action: I look down at the street surface and then glance up at the closed roller shutters of the adjacent building as I walk.

action: I stand on the street at night and look at a parked grey car.

action: I continue walking up the dark sloped street towards a set of stairs.

action: I walk along the dark outdoor path and ascend a wide flight of concrete stairs.
